t.Du parlé-chanté intimiste en Mi mineur v: From intimate spoken-sung verses in E minor to a bright, uplifting major-key chorus. A philosophy of life that sets letting go, love and poetry against the force of the elements.
t.Une œuvre contemplative sur le passage d: A contemplative song about the passing seasons, notebooks full of songs and the fulfilment of a man of 60. The motto of the show comes from this lyric:
t.Colonne vertébrale émotionnelle du réper: The emotional backbone of the repertoire: from 18 March 1997, the day of the haemorrhagic stroke when life hung by a thread, to waking from the coma on 1 April, then the patient recovery of walking, speech and the joy of fatherhood.
t.Chanson éponyme du récital écrite en hom: The title song of the recital, written as a tribute to pianist Marie-Françoise Coelho. A poetic, mischievous and sensual list song that makes the French language swing with deadpan wit.
t.offrant aux Éditeurs, Directeurs Artisti: giving publishers, A&R and music supervisors a complete dramaturgy. Song titles are kept in French; the full lyrics booklet and demos are available on request.
t.Portraits amoureux, espièglerie sensuell: Love portraits, sensual mischief, teenage memories and affectionate tributes.
t.Carnets d'itinérance, d'est en ouest et: Travel notebooks from east to west and north to south, between Alsatian roots and sunlit terraces.
t.La traversée de l'épreuve, la solitude u: Living through hardship, urban loneliness, the passing of time and the gratitude of being alive.
t.Jeux de langue, humanisme tempéré, fable: Wordplay, gentle humanism, a sharp fable and French-style dandyism.

t.Bertrand Charpilloz est un auteur-compos: Bertrand Charpilloz is a French singer-songwriter and lyricist, born on 20 January 1966 in Saverne, Alsace. He presents a repertoire of 21 original songs in French and the piano and voice recital L'Altesse Ego with pianist Marie-Françoise Coelho.
t.Quel style de musique fait-il ?: What kind of music does he make?
t.De la chanson française à texte, entre p: French literary chanson, between intimate spoken-sung delivery and cabaret blues, carried by a deep baritone voice. His references are Serge Gainsbourg, Alain Bashung, Benjamin Biolay and Alain Souchon.
t.Écrit-il ses propres chansons ?: Does he write his own songs?
t.Oui. Bertrand Charpilloz signe les parol: Yes. Bertrand Charpilloz writes the lyrics and music of all 21 songs in his catalogue.
t.Quelles chansons écouter en premier ?: Which songs should I listen to first?
t.« Sunset Boulevard », « Sur le creux de: « Sunset Boulevard », « Sur le creux de ma main », « Le Fil Rouge » and « Mon Altesse Ego », each in a Radio Edit and a piano and voice version on this page.
t.Quelle différence entre « L'Altesse Ego: What is the difference between « L'Altesse Ego » and « Mon Altesse Ego »?
t.« L'Altesse Ego » est le nom du récital: « L'Altesse Ego » is the name of the piano and voice recital. « Mon Altesse Ego » is a song from the repertoire, written as a tribute to pianist Marie-Françoise Coelho.
t.Quel est le lien entre sa musique et son: How is his music linked to his stroke?
t.Victime d'un AVC hémorragique en 1997, i: After a haemorrhagic stroke in 1997, he told the story of his recovery in the book « Mes liaisons cérébrales » (2013) and then in the song « Le Fil Rouge ».
t.Un duo piano-voix de 1 h 15 à 1 h 30, ou: A piano and voice duo of 75 to 90 minutes, or a 35-minute opening set. A team of 2 to 3 people, a tech rider of one piano and one vocal mic, soundcheck in 45 minutes, for venues of 80 to 500 seats.
